consumer: The frontend monster renderer asking 'what color does the GUI tint this visible monster by threat?' so it can draw the identical coloring.
scope: only the currently visible monsters (per-creature display reach), as gated by Creature::sees from the avatar
decisive_source: None of the excerpts is decisive: Excerpt 2 (write_entities monsters) exports raw hp/moves not a threat color, and Excerpt 3 (Creature::sees) computes visibility not the threat tint; the engine's monster-attitude/threat-to-color mapping that the GUI display consumes is NOT shown.
divergence: A monster whose raw hp and attitude would map to one tint but which the GUI draws differently because it is unseen (Creature::sees returns false) or a hallucination — emitting the raw-state color instead of the displayed color exposes the wrong authority.
